content: Hi, I am trying to use LeanGeo on macOS Tahoe 26.5.2 and I am experiencing a macOS dynamic-library loading problem. It seems to be an incompatibility between my pinned Lean toolchain (v4.15.0, from around late 2024) and macOS Tahoe's dyld hardening. It does not seem to be fixable from inside the project via lakefile edits. Has anyone on Tahoe experienced this problem?
